title: Two artwork proportions
slide_intent: Compare different image proportions because a flexible system must preserve recognition when the occupied area changes.
strategic_value: The paired compositions can show that Whitney’s mark stays recognizable around both a portrait-format image and a broad flag image.
demonstration: Two outlined vertical layouts pair W line drawings with differently shaped artworks: figures at left and a flag at right.
practical_value: Compare how the mark bends around each image while preserving the shared four-segment construction.

content_islands.name: Left layout
content_islands.spec: Place the narrower figurative artwork in the lower-left region and let the W occupy the space above and beside it.

content_islands.name: Right layout
content_islands.spec: Place the flag across the lower region with the compressed W above.

reference_purposes.Intent: The essay explicitly connects the variable W to the proportions of reproduced artworks.
reference_purposes.Application: Two preliminary layouts demonstrate different allocations of artwork and identity space.
